mnemonic.meaning: A mouth (口) that finds the advantage (利). Clever, smart.
mnemonic.reading: REE, COKE (りこう): the clever kid gets a free Coke.

examples.ja: この犬はとても利口だ。

items.note: Often for children and animals. お利口さん = good boy/girl. 賢い is the general word.

mnemonic.meaning: A special (特) thing it's good at (長). A strong point, a merit.
mnemonic.reading: TOE, CHOW (とくちょう): his strong point: he can eat chow with his toe. Same sound as 特徴 (feature).

examples.ja: この車の特長は燃費の良さだ。
examples.en: This car's selling point is its good fuel economy.

items.note: Only good points. 特徴 (same sound) is any distinctive feature, good or bad.

mnemonic.meaning: 碁 has 石 (stone): a game of black and white stones. Go.

examples.ja: 祖父は毎日碁を打っている。
examples.en: My grandfather plays Go every day.

items.note: Also 囲碁 (いご). You 'strike' it: 碁を打つ. 将棋 = Japanese chess.

mnemonic.meaning: 溶 has 氵 (water): mix it into water. To dissolve, to beat an egg.
mnemonic.reading: TOE, COO (とく): you beat an egg with your toe. Same sound as 解く (solve).

examples.ja: 卵を溶いてフライパンに入れる。
examples.en: Beat the eggs and pour them into the pan.

items.note: Cooking word: 溶き卵 = beaten egg. Same sound as 説く (Level 14), to explain.

mnemonic.reading: EE, RYO (いりょう): "Eee, Ryo, nice clothes!" Same sound as 医療 (medical care).

examples.ja: このビルには衣料品の店が多い。
examples.en: This building has a lot of clothing shops.

items.note: Shop and business word: 衣料品 (clothing goods). Same sound as 医療 (WaniKani), medical care.

mnemonic.meaning: Life (生), year (年), month (月), day (日). Your date of birth.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, NEN, GAP, PEE (せいねんがっぴ): say the year, month and day you were born.

examples.ja: ここに名前と生年月日を書いてください。
examples.en: Please write your name and date of birth here.

items.note: On almost every form. Note 月日 is read がっぴ here.

mnemonic.meaning: Master (修) the decoration (飾). Modification in grammar.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE, SHOCK (しゅうしょく): you decorate your shoe and get a shock. Same sound as 就職 (getting a job).

examples.ja: 形容詞は名詞を修飾する。

items.note: Grammar term: 修飾語 = modifier. Same sound as 就職 (getting a job).

mnemonic.meaning: Add (加) flavour (味). Seasoning, taking into account.
mnemonic.reading: CAR, ME (かみ): add seasoning to the car's dinner. Same sound as 神 (god) and 紙 (paper).

examples.ja: 成績には出席率も加味される。
examples.en: Attendance is also taken into account in grades.

items.note: Mostly 'factor in' in formal writing. Same sound as 紙 (paper) and 神 (god).

mnemonic.meaning: Money (金) to encourage (奨) study (学). A scholarship.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW GACK KIN (しょうがくきん): the show gives your kin a scholarship. GACK!

examples.ja: 奨学金をもらって留学した。
examples.en: I studied abroad on a scholarship.

items.note: In Japan, many 奨学金 must be paid back, so it often means a student loan.

mnemonic.meaning: Refined (精) calculation (算). Settling up the exact fare.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, SAN (せいさん): "Say, San, let's settle the bill." Same sound as 生産 (production).

examples.ja: 乗り越したので、改札の前で精算した。
examples.en: I went past my stop, so I paid the fare difference before the ticket gate.

items.note: Train stations have a 精算機 (fare adjustment machine). Same sound as 生産 (production) and 清算 (clearing a debt).

mnemonic.meaning: 訓 has 言 (words): native words. The kun reading.
mnemonic.reading: KOON (くん): the kun reading, like くん in names.

examples.en: The kun reading of 山 is やま.

items.note: 訓読み = kun reading. 音読み (おんよみ) = Chinese-derived reading. Also 'teaching': 教訓 (lesson).

mnemonic.reading: CAKE, KEY (けいき): the gauge measures how much cake is left. Same sound as 景気 (economy).

examples.ja: パイロットは計器を確認した。

items.note: Same sound as 景気 (Level 17), the economy.

mnemonic.meaning: Children's (童) ballad (謡). A nursery rhyme.
mnemonic.reading: DOUGH, YO (どうよう): "Dough, yo!" the kids sing a nursery rhyme. Same sound as 同様 and 動揺.

examples.ja: 子供たちが童謡を歌っている。
examples.en: The children are singing nursery rhymes.

items.note: Same sound as 同様 (Level 4), similar, and 動揺 (being shaken).

mnemonic.meaning: Above (上) your eyes (目). Your superior, your elders.
mnemonic.reading: MAY, WAY (めうえ): May shows her superior the way.

examples.ja: 目上の人には敬語を使う。
examples.en: You use polite language with people above you.

items.note: Higher in age or status. Opposite: 目下 (めした).

mnemonic.reading: SWEE, SEN (すいせん): sweet, the toilet flushes. Same sound as 推薦 (recommendation).

examples.ja: この家のトイレは水洗だ。
examples.en: The toilet in this house is a flush toilet.

items.note: 水洗トイレ = flush toilet. Same sound as 推薦 (recommendation).
